# Armor

Worn armor has a level from 0 (clothing) to 4, compared with the protection levels of NIJ Standard 0123.00. A round
is stopped by armor at or above its caliber's stop level ([Calibers](Calibers.md)). [Damage model](DamageModel.md)
explains what happens to a round that is stopped and one that gets through.

## Levels

| Level | NIJ rating | Rated energy (ft-lb) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | HG1 | 717 |
| 2 | HG2 | 1090 |
| 3 | RF1 | 2522 |
| 4 | RF3 | 3051 |

NIJ Standard 0123.00: level 1 is HG1, 2 is HG2, 3 is RF1, 4 is RF3. Energies are computed from its test masses and velocities.

## Armor rules

Each vanilla and DLC armor piece takes its level from the first rule its editor ID matches: a prefix exactly, a
"contains" rule in the lower-cased ID.
**Heavy** is the level with a heavy armor mod attached (an object mod whose editor ID matches
`^mod_armor_.*_Size_C$`). Armor no rule matches, including other mods' armor, takes a level from its armor
rating, scaled by the slots it covers: below 5 it is clothing, then levels 1 to 4 from ratings of 5, 15, 25 and 40 in
torso terms. A helmet is never above level 2.

## Ballistic Weave

The five Ballistic Weave tiers give the clothing they are applied to a fixed level, and the mod renames them to show it.

| Name | Editor ID | Level | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ballistic Weave Mk1 (Level 1) | `mod_armor_Railroad_ClothingArmor1` | 1 | Level 1 plating. Stops pistol rounds up to .357 Magnum. |
| Ballistic Weave Mk2 (Level 1) | `mod_armor_Railroad_ClothingArmor2` | 1 | Level 1 plating. Stops pistol rounds up to .357 Magnum. |
| Ballistic Weave Mk3 (Level 2) | `mod_armor_Railroad_ClothingArmor3` | 2 | Level 2 plating. Stops pistol rounds up to .44 Magnum. |
| Ballistic Weave Mk4 (Level 3) | `mod_armor_Railroad_ClothingArmor4` | 3 | Level 3 plating. Stops rifle rounds up to 7.62x51mm. |
| Ballistic Weave Mk5 (Level 4) | `mod_armor_Railroad_ClothingArmor5` | 4 | Level 4 plating. Stops armor piercing rifle rounds up to .30-06. |

## Heads and limbs

- A killing head hit can burst the head when the round carries at least 2700 ft-lb within
  5 m, at least 7000 ft-lb at any range, or is a heavy shotgun
  round (`12ga`, `10gauge`, `8ga`, `4ga`) within 10 m.
- A killing limb hit can sever the limb when the round carries at least 7000 ft-lb.
